adjudication.rationale: The diff changes PostRevisor#update_post to `@post.save(validate: !@opts[:skip_validations])` and still ignores the boolean return. In the new embed update path (`TopicEmbed.import` calls `revisor.revise!(..., skip_validations: true)`), a non-exception save failure (e.g., callback abort) would not be detected, yet `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, ...)` would still run, risking an inconsistent embed record vs. post content. However, the diff does not prove such a failure will occur (and save return was also ignored before), so it's a robustness concern rather than a clearly verifiable defect.
